What the grid says
  • Best, ongoing (real) last n, Negative windows 5,10: Base long 50 / short 5 / minimal -2, Main static 25, Real 5: executed PF 1.157 on 654 orders (halves 1.165 / 1.103), effective PF 1.519 (in-sample), 0.27% of the Sets validated.
  • Best, ongoing (real) last n, Negative windows 1,2: Base long 50 / short 5 / minimal -3, Main static 25, Real 1: executed PF 1.211 on 226 orders (halves None / 1.211), effective PF 1.362 (in-sample), 0.01% of the Sets validated.
  • Shipped setting (long 50, short 25, Main 25, Real 15): executed PF 0.938 on 1711 orders, effective PF 1.689, 3.74% validated.
  • Spread: executed PF runs from 0.53 to 1.21 over 774 cells; 104 of 755 cells with at least 150 orders are at or above 1.00.
  • In-sample against executed: the effective PF averages 1.72, the executed PF 0.92; across the cells the two correlate at r = -0.16. A window setting that lifts the effective PF is not thereby better executed.
  • Noise: one 24 h window and a few hundred orders per cell: a PF difference of 0.1 between neighbouring cells is inside the noise, and the best cell is chosen on this same window, so it is in-sample for that choice. Cells under 150 orders (†) are not ranked.
